# Historical publication pilot inputs

These source snapshots keep the retained P3 pilot's boundary and rendering tests independent of
the current documentation structure. They are test inputs, not user-facing documentation.

The manifest and five source documents are frozen at the approved V9 pilot commit `fb9aca81`.
The workflow diagram is retained separately at `tests/fixtures/docs-pilot/shape-of-a-run.html`.

Do not synchronize these snapshots with live editorial revisions. Current publication coverage
belongs to `tests/test_publications.py` and the complete HTML/PDF builds.
